top_signals.title: Rates Spark: Geopolitics in focus ahead of US CPI
top_signals.summary: Everything hinges on two more US CPI readings US rates ended last week with a dovish aftertaste on the back of poor payroll numbers, but the CPI figure this week should be more instrumental. Until September’s Federal Reserve meeting, we only have two more CPI readings. And markets still need to make up their minds ...
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
